turns.teacherReply: Namaste Aarav, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj odd-even numbers seekhenge—video game ke levels jaise! Tumhe kaunsa video game pasand hai?

ask.text: Tumhe kaunsa video game pasand hai?

turns.teacherReply: Tum kya sochte ho?

move.shape: open with one concrete everyday situation built on their interest (video games) — kit contexts: dance partners, rotis and laddoos, cricket runs; ask what they think will happen or which they would pick — a prediction, no right answer yet; any bigger/more comparison: two quantities of one kind, in one unit — a count against a count, a distance against a distance; never across kinds; mention once: at the end they will teach this to Golu (a pretend baby elephant just starting school); address them with tum forms (tum, tumhara, tumne), never tu

ask.text: Tum kya sochte ho?

turns.teacherReply: Aarav, zero even hai: whiteboard par 0 objects ko pairs mein rakho—koi object akela nahi bachta; tum 4 ko kaise jodoge?
